ingredients.name: Vitamin A
ingredients.shortDesc:
Found in: Carrots, Green leafy vegetables and Eggs

Form: Retinol palmitate

Amount: 510 mcg

Our paediatricians say: Around here we have a saying: Vitamin A keeps the eye-doctors away! And yet it’s amongst the most common deficiencies in preschool children, affecting 62% of kids. For 100% health, we give you 100% of the recommended serving!

ingredients.name: Vitamin D3
ingredients.shortDesc:
Found in: Fish, mushrooms, cheese, egg yolks etc.

Form: Cholecalciferol (vegetarian source lichen)

Amount: 600 IU

 Our paediatricians say: Vitamin D3 is a very underrated mineral for growing children. Your kids may grow out of their clothes, but they'll never grow out of good old natural minerals. For parents with fussy children - slip our supplements into their chocolate milk, they'll never know!

ingredients.name: Vitamin C
ingredients.shortDesc:
Found in: Oranges, Amla, strawberry etc.

Form: Ascorbic acid

Amount: 20 mg

Our paediatricians say: Vitamin C can stop bruises to the knee! Vitamin C helps form and repair red blood cells, bones, and tissues. In addition, vitamin C helps cuts and wounds heal, boosts the immune system, and keeps infections at bay.

ingredients.name: Vitamin B12
ingredients.shortDesc:
Found in: Fish, meats, milk, egg yolk etc.

Form: Cyanocobalamin

Amount: 2.2 mcg

Our paediatricians says: Vitamin B12 is our supermineral. It turns food into energy, which in turn fuels overall health and development. Most natural B12 is found in animal sources and this is especially good for vegetarians! As a supermineral, we supply 100% of the recommended serving.

ingredients.name: Vitamin B9
ingredients.shortDesc:
Found in: Spinach, Kiwi, Nuts, Egg yolk, etc.

Form: Dietary folate

Amount: 102 mcg

Our paediatricians say: Folates are important for several functions in the brain and body including the proper formation of the nervous system. Our product supplies approx. 75% of Vitamin B9 RDA per serving.

ingredients.name: Zinc
ingredients.shortDesc:
Found in: Meat, Legumes, Milk, Eggs, etc.

Form: Zinc citrate

Amount: 1 mg

Our paediatricians say: Zinc is one of those rare minerals that’s great all around for your child’s health, including their attention span, motor development, height and weight. Move aside, energy drinks! There’s a new hero on the block.

ingredients.name: Curcumin
ingredients.shortDesc:
Found in: Turmeric

Form: Curcumin

Amount: 5 mg

Our paediatricians say: Curcumin is anti-inflammatory, anti-allergic and antioxidant. It’s great for your child’s immune system, naturally sourced, and can be mixed into anything!

ingredients.name: DHA
ingredients.shortDesc:
Found in: Flaxseed

Form: Docosahexaenoic Acid (DHA)

Amount: 15 mg

Our paediatricians say: If there was a nutritional hero, it would be DHA. DHA is vital to the structure of the brain and may improve learning, memory, immunity and inflammation. Vegetarian kids are especially deficient in DHA. Our supplement is vegtarian.

faqs.question: How are Little Joy's gummies sweet without adding sugar?
faqs.answer: Our gummies get their sweetness from chicory root fibre, a clinically studied prebiotic that's fantastic for gut health & immunity. It adds sweetness naturally, without affecting blood sugar levels. No hidden sugars here—it's a promise!

faqs.question: How will this build immunity?
faqs.answer: It takes over 90 days to build immunity by filling nutritional gaps, improving diet and other good habits. Our multivitamin gummmies prevent micro-nutrient deficiencies and improve kids' diet through fibre from fruits & vegetables. See ingredients for details, we have nothing to hide.

faqs.question: How many gummies to eat per day? Can I give 2 different Little Joys Gummies to my kid at one go?
faqs.answer: While we recommend giving your kid one gummy a day, you CAN give them any two Little Joys gummies at one go. Please note while they are yummy, these gummies aren't candies. It is safe to consume up to 3 gummies at once for healthy children (not daily).

faqs.question: Are they actually healthy? What are they made of?
faqs.answer: 85% of each gummy is made of a prebiotic fibre called chicory root unlike others gummies where the base is of refined sugar. Chicory is excellent for digestion and helps in nutrient absorption. We use 100% natural strawberry flavours and colours without adding any sugar on top.

faqs.question: Should Kids Take Vitamins in the Morning or at Night?
faqs.answer: Taking multivitamins in the morning with breakfast is generally recommended, as this can help ensure optimal absorption and utilisation of the nutrients throughout the day. Try to give gummies after eating food for better absorption of nutrients.

faqs.question: How many gummies are there in one pack of Little Joys Multivitamin Gummies?
faqs.answer: A single pack of Little Joys Multivitamin Gummies contain 30 gummies. "30N" at the end of the name denotes 30 gummies for 30 days.

faqs.question: My child has a balanced diet and eats everything. Should I still give multivitamin gummies?
faqs.answer: Our primary aim is for kids to  receive all the required vitamins and nutrients necessary for their overall health and development. This can be through diet but more often than not because of the eating habits of the kids it becomes problematic to make them eat a well-balanced diet. Further, what we may think is a well-balanced diet may miss some essential vitamins and nutrients. Little joys multivitamin gummies ensure that all the necessary vitamins and nutrients are given to your kid in a fun filled manner.

faqs.question: Are these gummies bad for my child's teeth?
faqs.answer: Little Joys Gummies are made with natural sweeteners and contain no added sugars, making them a healthier choice than regular gummies. However, like all gummies, they can stick to teeth and may contribute to cavities if good oral hygiene isn't followed. For best dental health, don't give more than 1-2 gummies in a day and encourage your child to brush or rinse their mouth after eating.
